# task 2468 navbar visual restyle
Task 2468 restyles the zhi2-web-admin Navbar to match the reference design and is accepted only at 99.5% full-image E2E similarity.

## Worktree and Staging
- Worktree worktrees/task2468-navbar-visual; on 2026-11-15 the local site was restored to baseline commit 0e14875de and the candidate changes stayed only in the worktree.
- Both Navbar visual branches were 0 ahead / 0 behind the project mainline; only Navbar source and related assets were staged.
- Submodule staging covered Navbar, mapping/generated code, 36 icons and background assets; `git diff --cached --check` passed.
- A trailing blank line in the generated script was fixed and `node --check` passed; commit order is submodule first, parent repo second.

## Commits
- On 2026-11-15 the user explicitly instructed committing and pushing to the main branch, so the worktree, submodule and remote mainline were checked first; 92.707% was still not treated as visual acceptance.
- Submodule commit 9ba4ccc0dcbae04ac8460854186587b2a1391f0b (`feat(navbar): restyle top navigation`); parent commit ba246959ba1477131c03d88af11b850ff9e6b976 (`feat(navbar): update submodule and add visual E2E`); pushed to develop/v2.6.2-suzhufang.
- Remote SHA verified identical and the local mainline checkout was fast-forwarded; no other uncommitted files were included and nothing was deployed.
- Post-commit production build passed and its hash matched the submodule commit.

## Acceptance Results
- Best candidate reached Navbar background height 105% with full-image E2E 92.707%, below the 99.5% threshold.
- A 15px active-tab trial scored 92.712% (about 0.005 pp better) and was not kept; the source parameters were retained.
- Official E2E passed navigation overflow, scroll-arrow and empty-permission checks; the icon-excluded 94.168% score is diagnostic only.
- Navbar lint, E2E script syntax check and build passed; temporary diagnostic hooks were cleared and pre-commit review found no debug hooks.
- Default profile.png was changed only to the reference-aligned user silhouette; the placeholder scenario shows it while real avatars still display.

## Remaining Gap
- On 2026-11-15 the build finished with exit 0 and the plan was one candidate deploy plus formal E2E, restoring the baseline if the score stayed below threshold.
- The final candidate was built and E2E passed, then the original site version was restored; the remaining gap is mainly the real menu icons, because local `/zhi2-pro/...` paths return 404 and upstream returns HTML, pending a usable image URL or files from the user.

# bug 6899 live-report hover card
Bug 6899 is a zhi2-web-admin big-screen defect in which the hover card of live-report items (实时上报) renders incorrectly.

## Scope
- The fix lives in `index.vue`; 6 code edits were already landed before the 2026-11-24 session resumed the handoff.
- Working scope is only `index.vue` plus the task ledger; the repo carries many pre-existing unrelated modifications that must not be touched.
- The ledger already contains an unrelated pre-existing insertion, so bug-6899 entries are appended without touching it.

## Verification
- 2026-11-24 static checks passed: ESLint exit 0 and `npm test` (test-mode Vite build) exit 0, with `dist` regenerated at 09:27:41.
- The test-mode build must run in the background through the watchdog script, keeping state and logs in a temp dir rather than the project dir.
- The bug data exists only for a specific warning event carrying live-report items for 里双桥小区 (records timestamped 17:57:51 and 17:55:58); the default big-screen view shows all counts as 0.
- A direct browser fetch of the realtime API returns 401 without the app auth token, so the data must be located by driving the real UI or querying the test DB with the correct connection ID.

## Remaining Steps
- Real-machine verification plus screenshot → user confirmation → ledger entry → zentao writeback → commit decision → cleanup.
- Browser session used for verification matches the handoff session, with the big-screen page loaded and login state valid.

# zhi2-web-admin
zhi2-web-admin (苏住房G) is the 苏住房 admin web frontend, led by the 苏住房 frontend project Lead, who decides task assignment and implementation plans and is responsible for development and visual acceptance.

## Project Info
- Repo root D:/repository/苏住房G on Windows (D: drive).
- Navbar component is src/layout/components/Navbar.vue; the visual regression case is e2e/home-v2/navbar-visual.spec.mjs.
- Full-image E2E visual acceptance threshold is 99.5% similarity.
- Owned by the 苏住房 frontend project Lead, whose 禅道 account is tiany.
- Related norm: real `meta.icon` takes priority over the title fallback when adjusting visual candidates.

## Worktree and Commits
- Commits must be made in an isolated worktree so the main workspace and other worktrees keep their retained changes.
- Baseline build and follow-up verification run at the original repo root with the same installed dependencies.
- An isolated worktree's dependency layout may not hit the project Vite, so the baseline build can exit within a second; this is not a source error.
- Vite treats the parent repo directory as `env` and `dist` root, so an isolated worktree must keep the full parent repo structure to avoid reading the wrong env or writing the wrong output directory.
- A build log silent for 120 seconds may still be running and can finish normally, so it should not be rerun.

## Build and Staging
- Candidate and formal builds always set an absolute staging `outDir`; the formal `dist` is replaced only after the staging full E2E and version check pass, and the backup is restored on failure or when test markers are scanned.
- A test-mode build (`npm test`) is run in the background through the watchdog, keeping state and logs in a temp dir instead of the project dir.
- E2E runs through a one-shot watchdog wrapper that disables and then re-enables the original config via the UI helper in `finally`, instead of editing the enabled config file.
- The candidate site's HTTP response must match the worktree build; this was confirmed consistent on 2026-11-14.
- E2E acceptance must cover empty permissions, bidirectional scrolling, active-item visibility and a test-marker scan; `vite.config.js` main-checkout builds output to the repo-root `dist`, which matches the local nginx site.

## Acceptance and Tasks
- Task 2468 (Navbar visual restyle) details are kept in the task2468_navbar_visual entity.
- Bug 6899 (big-screen live-report hover card) is still in real-machine verification.
- On 2026-11-24 the delivery-chain end flow is real-machine verification → screenshot into the session → user confirmation → commit and Zentao writeback → cleanup; work is at hop 2 with code changes done, proceeding on the unfinished items in section 4 of the handoff doc.
- The 2026-11-24 start snapshot matches the handoff: parent repo dirty=5 and submodule dirty=7 are unrelated to this task and must not be touched; the `screen-motion` worktree is also not touched.
- The local site runs on port 8101; its login page has a graphic captcha (on 2026-11-24 an arithmetic `6 * 9 = 54`), so use agent-browser to establish a session, then fill account, password and captcha to log in.
